title: FeedSport programme phases mapped to CFIA maximum-nutrient columns
rule: Each supported phase maps to exactly one CFIA column. Growing pigs: the column whose published weight range contains the midpoint of the phase's published weight range. Broilers: the column containing the midpoint of the phase's age range, with day 28 (the 4-week start of the Grower column) as the Starter/Grower boundary. Gestating gilts and sows: Dry sows. Lactating gilts and sows: Lactating sows. Mature boars: Sexually active boars. A phase not listed here has no CFIA reference and is reported as unsupported; FeedSport never infers a column at run time.
unsupportedPolicy: Phases absent from this list are reported with an explicit unsupported status and no upper-limit comparison.
